title: Naturally Crispy Norwegian Squid Skewers
description: A jammy and crispy Norwegian dish featuring squid, this recipe is a unique and adventurous take on traditional seafood, boiled to perfection and served in a bamboo steamer, making it vegetarian friendly by omitting typical seafood accompaniments.

ingredients.name: squid tubes
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite sized pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the squid pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated squid pieces onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in a bamboo steamer and steam for 5 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the steamer and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the skewers from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
